farmToFood.headline: From Farm to Food — in Six Stages
farmToFood.description: Scroll through the full journey below. Every seed, every harvest, every plate is part of one African story.

s1.headline: Seeds of Africa.
s1.description: Sourced from smallholder farms and cooperatives across Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire, and Nigeria — maize, cocoa, shea, and indigenous crops like fonio and tiger nuts.

s2.headline: Golden harvest.
s2.description: Hand-picked and mechanically harvested at peak ripeness. Each batch undergoes farm-gate quality grading per Ghana Standards Authority (GSA) protocols.

s3.headline: Modern transformation.
s3.description: HACCP and ISO 22000-certified facilities in the Greater Accra region. Cleaning, sorting, milling, and blending — precision at every step.

s4.headline: Ready for the shelf.
s4.description: Shelf-stable packaging meeting EU, USFDA, and ECOWAS food-safety requirements. Every label tells the origin story of its contents.

s5.headline: Great food.
s5.description: From our kitchens to yours. Jollof spice blends, roasted cocoa nibs, cassava flour — nutritious, culturally rooted ingredients and ready meals.

s6.headline: For the world.
s6.description: Distributed across 24+ markets through Africa Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) corridors and partnerships with EU and North American importers.

about.originParagraph1: Acres X Manna was born in Accra, Ghana, from a simple observation: Africa produces over 60% of the world's cocoa, yet less than 5% of its chocolate. We set out to close that value gap — not just in cocoa, but across grains, shea, fruits, and ready meals — by building world-class processing right where the crops grow.
about.originParagraph2: Today, we operate modern food-manufacturing lines that pair community-first sourcing with international food-safety certifications (HACCP, ISO 22000, Ghana FDA). The result: premium African-made products that stand on any shelf, anywhere.
about.pillarsDescription: Three promises we make to our farmers, our partners, and our customers every day.
about.pillar1Description: Every story starts with a seed — ours in the hands of African smallholder farmers and cooperatives who tend the land. We build for them first, paying 18–32% above local market rates to incentivize quality.
about.pillar2Description: We combine ancestral craft with modern food manufacturing. Hygiene, traceability, and flavour engineering meet age-old knowledge inside HACCP-certified facilities near Tema, Ghana.
about.pillar3Description: Africa's food on every major shelf in the world. Through AfCFTA corridors and direct partnerships with European and North American retailers, we carry the continent's story farther each year.
about.pullquote: We don't just export food — we export the dignity of African labor and the joy of our tables.

impact.description: Every number on this page is a person, a community, or a meal on a table we helped get there.
impact.story1Text: "Since joining the Acres X Manna outgrower program in 2022, I received training on improved OPV maize varieties, a guaranteed off-take contract, and a 32% higher price at harvest. My children's school fees are now covered every term."
impact.story2Text: "Premium cocoa prices year on year, plus a school scholarship fund covering 240 farmer families. We've invested in fermentation sheds and now grade our beans to EU export standard ourselves."
impact.story3Name: Nana Afia — Production Lead, Tema Factory
impact.story3Text: "I started as a seasonal temp on the packaging line in 2021. After completing Acres X Manna's internal skills program, I now lead a team of 14 in the milling department, working with GMP and HACCP protocols daily."
